videos.title: Teleshopping
videos.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

videos.title: Wycliffe
videos.description: When an attempt is made to steal a headless, thirty-year-old skeleton from an archaeological dig, Wycliffe and the team discover an estate steeped in archaic values.

videos.title: Wycliffe
videos.description: When surfer Anne Carter is discovered in a deep coma on the beach, evidence points to an accident or a possible suicide attempt, but as Wycliffe and the team investigate, they discover a plot far more sinister.

videos.title: Wycliffe
videos.description: An abandoned lorry with five corpses at the ferry terminal and a man on the run bring Wycliffe's silver wedding anniversary celebrations to an abrupt halt.

videos.title: Wycliffe
videos.description: The Bodmin community is shocked when unexplained killings begin to occur. Frightened by these unexplained tragedies, the locals begin to believe a local myth has reared its ugly head.

videos.title: Midsomer Murders
videos.description: When a survivalist is found murdered in his bombproof shelter, Barnaby unravels a dark conspiracy to reveal how far people will go to escape the end of the world.

videos.title: ITV Racing
videos.description: Ed Chamberlin presents live racing from Haydock, Aintree and Punchestown. Today's feature meeting is at Haydock where the Grade 1 Betfair Chase is the highlight of the day and features some of the top stayers in early season action.

videos.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot
videos.description: When an elderly woman is poisoned in her home, the obvious culprit seems to be her companion. Having met the dead woman earlier at the Chelsea Flower Show, Poirot hurries to her home, and his new-found interest in gardening pays off when he spots something fishy in the garden border.

videos.title: Midsomer Murders
videos.description: When a farmer is found horribly murdered in the middle of a stone circle, suspicion points at a group of druids. DCI John Barnaby and DS Jones hurry to the scene of the crime, where they are joined by new pathologist Kate Wilding on her first assignment. Druid high priest Leticia Clifford shows Barnaby that sacred ley lines run through the stone circle and later is convinced she has made an exciting discovery.

videos.title: Midsomer Murders
videos.description: Barnaby and Jones enter the cloistered and old-fashioned world of Midsomer Priory after a nun is found strangled. Jones visits the local pub, where he learns that a woman was seen acting strangely on the day of the murder, and that teenagers in the area sneak into the priory grounds for romantic liaisons. Later, the nuns discover that a valuable silver altar set has vanished, then the chaplain is found murdered.

videos.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot
videos.description: When a beautiful young actress is the sole witness to the murder of a shady impresario, her fiancé Prince Paul of Maruania asks Poirot to remove her from suspicion.

videos.title: Midsomer Murders
videos.description: Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile, publican Samuel Quested says that he wants to restore an ancient rite called the Stag in which men go in search of women from another village in order to 'refresh the gene pool'. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

videos.title: Vera
videos.description: When charred remains are discovered in an abattoir furnace, DCI Vera Stanhope is called to investigate the horrific circumstances that led to the murder.

videos.description: The disappearance of a young boy at Denton Football Club leads Frost into a disturbing story of child abuse and paedophilia. In addition to the usual pressures in his life, Frost must also decide whether to accept a promotion to Chief Inspector.

videos.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot
videos.description: Hastings receives an invitation to visit his friends at Styles St Mary, where he meets an old acquaintance from the Belgian police force. When Hastings discovers that their hostess has been murdered, a crime-solving partnership is born.

videos.title: McDonald and Dodds
videos.description: When a body is found in a shallow grave, in the shadow of the Glastonbury Tor, a sinister sequence of events is triggered, which only DS Dodds can decipher.

videos.title: Downton Abbey
videos.description: A change of circumstance puts Bertie Pelham in the limelight, and Edith must decide whether to conceal her past at all costs or confront the truth and risk losing everything. As both sisters seek their perfect match, hostilities escalate, and it is up to Mary to decide if she can ever make peace with Edith - or herself? Spratt proves to be a man of hidden talents and Mr Molesley embarks on a career in teaching, though his first lesson does not quite go to plan.

videos.title: Downton Abbey
videos.description: Mary endeavours to build bridges with her sister while Edith's secret continues to pose a threat. As Henry settles into the role of husband and stepfather, finding his place at Downton proves more difficult.

videos.title: Midsomer Murders
videos.description: Barnaby and Jones investigate when the appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths among an aristocratic family called the DeQuettevilles. Meanwhile, the family stage a Civil War re-enactment with their hostile neighbours and relive historic battles. Can the detectives uncover the truth about the DeQuettevilles and the ghostly rider in order to prevent more murders?

videos.title: Midsomer Murders
videos.description: When convicted murderer Grady Felton returns to the village where he killed a boy years earlier, his arrival is met with anger from the locals. Soon afterwards, a barrister is killed in Midsomer and suspicion falls on Grady. Grady has a solid alibi, but Barnaby suspects that he is working with an accomplice - until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.
